item.text: [{"task_id":"a65b410d","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    red = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    above = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    below = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    slope = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    out = grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == red)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return out","    row = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    start = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    length = int(np.count_nonzero(grid[row] == red))","    columns = np.arange(grid.shape[1])","    for y in range(grid.shape[0]):","        if y != row:","            width = length + slope * (row - y)","            mask = (columns >= start) & (columns < start + width) & (grid[y] == background)","            if y < row:","                out[y, mask] = above","            else:","                out[y, mask] = below","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,3,1,1]},"rationale":"Extend the red segment into a left-aligned triangle: each row upward gains one cell and is green; each row downward loses one cell and is blue.
